name: Tessera
description: Credit identity layer for AI agents on Base. Public deterministic Tessera Score (0-100) over on-chain activity, plus paid x402 endpoints: GET /api/x402/score/[address] ($0.001 USDC) returns the full score breakdown for any wallet; GET /api/x402/agent/[address] ($0.002 USDC) returns the combined Score + verified Agent Directory profile. Settlement via Coinbase facilitator on Base mainnet, EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization.
